title: 2D Contour: add finish controls with undo support

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add the finish controls specified in #4204 through the existing staged parameter editor.
Depend on the core, source and safety issues linked from #4204.
Read crates/ui/AGENTS.md before implementation.

Add Finish in this operation to Passes. Hide the finish fields while it is off.
Use an allowance of 0.25 mm, one finishing pass and no spring passes when the operator enables it.
Use the count limits from #4204.

Add the independent Override finish feed control to Feeds.
Enable copies the current Feed. Disable clears the override and restores inheritance.
Enable again copies the new current Feed. An active override does not follow later Feed edits.
Keep the override when the finish sequence is disabled. It has no cutting effect until the sequence is enabled again.
Use EditOperationParams. Do not change the tool recipe or spindle speed.
Opening a tab must not modify parameters.

Evidence:
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs, Contour arm.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/feeds_page.rs.
- crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs, OpParams::Contour.

Done means: UI tests cover defaults, visibility, count limits, feed copy and inheritance.
Tests cover Feed edits with an active override, disable and enable, Apply, undo and redo.
A test proves that opening either tab changes no value.
A UI-created operation produces the same settings as an equivalent MCP-created operation.

Effort: high. The controls add behavior that changes generated G-code. The safety floor applies.
Priority: P6. This issue adds the feature controls.

Part of #4204
